newsitem.title: USA: US August home-builders mkt index rises to 58.
newsitem.headline: US August home-builders mkt index rises to 58.

text.p: The National Association of Home Builders (NAHB) said its Housing Market Index rose to 58 from the revised July figure of 56.
Builders' ratings of single-family home sales increased to 61 in August from July's 59, NAHB said.
Meanwhile, traffic of prospective buyers rose to 48 in August from 45 in July, and the component index for single-family sales in the next six months rose to 66 from 64.
A Housing Market Index over 50 generally means the number of positive responses received from builders exceeded the number of negative responses.

"Declining interest rates during most of the month helped improve customer traffic, current sales and builder outlook, the three components of the Housing Market Index," said Kent Colton, executive vice president of the NAHB.
